course.adab.title: Manners and Morals Course
course.adab.subtitle: Manners and morals from Surah Al-Fatihah, Surah Luqman and Surah Al-Hujurat
course.adab.short_description: A short course in three lessons from “The Concise Commentary on the Noble Quran” (Al-Mukhtasar): sincere servitude to Allah in Al-Fatihah, wisdom in Luqman, and good manners with the Prophet ﷺ in Al-Hujurat, with comprehension questions after each lesson.
course.adab.description: This course covers the manners and morals of a Muslim as outlined in three surahs of the Noble Quran, with an accessible commentary from “The Concise Commentary on the Noble Quran” (Al-Mukhtasar). It begins with Surah Al-Fatihah and its call to worship Allah sincerely and to seek His help alone, then the opening of Surah Luqman and the qualities of the good-doers who benefit from wisdom, then the opening of Surah Al-Hujurat and its manners with Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, including lowering one’s voice in his presence. Each lesson has the page recitation, the commentary on its verses and short comprehension questions, and the course ends with a final exam.
course.adab.lesson.1.title: Surah Al-Fatihah
course.adab.lesson.1.subtitle: Sincere servitude to Allah · Verses 1–7
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.text: Why is Surah Al-Fatihah called by this name?
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.a: Because the Book of Allah opens with it
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.b: Because it was the last surah revealed
course.adab.lesson.1.q1.c: Because it is the longest surah of the Quran
course.adab.lesson.1.q2.text: What is meant by “Yawm ad-Din” in His saying {مَٰلِكِ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ}?
course.adab.lesson.1.q2.b: The Day of Recompense and Reckoning
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.text: What is the straight path we ask Allah to guide us to?
course.adab.lesson.1.q3.a: Islam, the clear path that has no crookedness in it
course.adab.lesson.2.title: Surah Luqman
course.adab.lesson.2.subtitle: Wisdom and the qualities of the good-doers · Verses 1–11
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.text: Which of these is an objective of Surah Luqman?
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.a: Commanding to follow the wisdom contained in the Quran, and warning against turning away from it
course.adab.lesson.2.q1.c: The story of the People of the Cave
course.adab.lesson.2.q2.text: For whom did Allah make the verses of the Book guidance and mercy at the start of Surah Luqman?
course.adab.lesson.2.q2.c: For those who buy idle talk
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.text: How does the arrogant person respond when the verses of Allah are recited to him, as described in the seventh verse?
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.a: He hurries to listen to them
course.adab.lesson.2.q3.c: He turns away as if he had not heard them
course.adab.lesson.3.title: Surah Al-Hujurat
course.adab.lesson.3.subtitle: Manners with the Prophet ﷺ · Verses 1–4
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.text: Which of these is an objective of Surah Al-Hujurat?
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.a: Narrating the stories of earlier prophets
course.adab.lesson.3.q1.b: Disciplining the tongue and showing its effect on the individual’s faith and on the morals of society
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.text: What manner does the first verse of Surah Al-Hujurat command?
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.a: That the believers do not put themselves before Allah and His Messenger in word or deed
course.adab.lesson.3.q2.c: Raising one’s voice in the presence of the Prophet ﷺ
course.adab.lesson.3.q3.text: What is the reward of those who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
course.adab.quiz.title: Comprehension questions
course.adab.exam.title: Final exam
course.adab.exam.q1.text: What does the name “Allah” mean, according to the commentary on the Basmalah?
course.adab.exam.q1.a: The One truly worthy of worship
course.adab.exam.q2.text: In His saying {إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ}, from whom do we seek help?
course.adab.exam.q3.text: How did Allah describe the good-doers at the start of Surah Luqman?
course.adab.exam.q3.a: They take the verses of Allah in ridicule
course.adab.exam.q3.b: They establish prayer, give zakah and are certain of the Hereafter
course.adab.exam.q4.text: What does the second verse of Surah Al-Hujurat warn against?
course.adab.exam.q4.a: Raising voices above the voice of the Prophet ﷺ
course.adab.exam.q5.text: What do the three lessons of this course call to?
course.adab.exam.q5.b: Good manners with Allah and His Messenger, and good character
